title: [review] lichend.rs: TUN receive errors silently swallowed
description: In run_hat_inner, the TUN receive result is handled with `if let Ok(n) = result`, silently discarding errors. This is inconsistent with run_serial_inner (line 549) and run_sim_inner (line 448) which both log and break on TUN errors. A failing TUN could go unnoticed indefinitely.
